The discussion states initial management included drainage procedures, whereas the case text states the planned tympanic membrane incision was cancelled and describes no drainage procedure performed. The discussion also says residual high-frequency tinnitus persisted "after the procedure" without naming any procedure.

The case says hearing normalized within a week, but the posttreatment audiogram and tympanogram in the figure captions are dated 8 August 2024, 14 days after the 25 July 2024 initial tests, and the vHIT follow-up is dated 29 July 2024.
The bedside ocular motor examination is reported as normal smooth pursuit, whereas videonystagmography reports type II smooth pursuit (called impairment in the Fig. 3 caption).

The source says the patient was intolerant and unable to cooperate with the caloric test before treatment, but does not state whether the test was started, abandoned or not performed, and gives no result.

Hearing is reported as normalized (text: within a week; Fig. 1 caption: complete normalization of right ear thresholds on 8 August 2024), yet the discussion states she was diagnosed with persistent high-frequency sensorineural hearing loss, at an unstated time.

The Fig. 3 caption reports resolution of spontaneous nystagmus and mild residual positional nystagmus after treatment, while the text says horizontal nystagmus gradually abated and upbeat nystagmus resolved completely.
